verdict.rationale: Rev AI's docs say it automatically adds punctuation and applies inverse text normalization (number formatting) to all audio, and the marketing page claims proper punctuation and formatting. That covers the formatting half of the story. Nothing documents a way to turn formatting off: "on all audio processed" suggests it is always on, and the disfluency-removal setting is a different control. Missing for 10: a documented option to disable punctuation/normalization, explicit casing documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off

citations.quote: Rev AI automatically adds punctuation and performs inverse text normalization on all audio processed.
High accuracy across 57+ languages with proper grammar, punctuation, and formatting.
